verdict.rationale: Isaac is a robotics simulation and learning platform, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence only shows 'agent skills' for Isaac Lab and an 'AI agent skill' for upgrading ROS 2 nodes. Those are packaged skills for external coding agents, an adjacent feature rather than an assistant built into the product that users can delegate tasks to, so there is no direct evidence for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
